title: Hearty Spicy Russian Knafeh Pilaf
description: A spicy and springy Russian dish featuring knafeh, perfect for meal prep, served on a talavera plate. This low-calorie-friendly meal is a twist on traditional Russian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the knafeh, brown rice, and smoked paprika.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat and cook the chicken breast until browned.
Add the sliced spicy sausage to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large talavera plate or baking dish, combine the cooked chicken, sausage, onion, and garlic mixture.
Add the fermented vegetables on top of the mixture.
Add the knafeh and brown rice mixture on top of the fermented vegetables.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the knafeh is golden brown.
